title: Teach the leader per-task routing and the two-worker rule
action: In packages/bee/LEADER.md: add the per-task route step (classify the task, run bee orient --class <c>, seed the session todo list with that playbook's steps, a skipped step kept with skip: and its reason) and a trigger index of at most ten lines that points from a situation to the owning skill, never restating it; rewrite the agents-never-zero-execution-workers rule so every code cell has a dispatched implementer and a separate tester and tiny no longer runs inline. In bee-planning SKILL.md replace 'The writer owns tests' with tester cells per D1-D3. In bee-swarming SKILL.md state the tester contract and the red-tester path (BLOCKED, leader reopens the implementer, fresh dispatch) and the principle answer at cap. Note in routing-and-contracts.md that playbook steps seed the todo list as a projection. Update the tiny row in gates-and-delegation.md. In each playbook's Proof line, point to the cap floor table (bee cells finish --help) without copying values. Run bee dev regen.

truths: LEADER.md carries the per-task route step and the trigger index
No doctrine line still lets a code cell certify itself or run tiny inline
Each playbook points to the floor table
prohibitions: Never restate a skill's description in the trigger index
Never copy floor values into playbooks
